affected_authorities.finding: The coarse observed_atac input label left EpiBERT, EPCOTv2, GET, and unresolved embedding/decoder families potentially query-eligible even though they require sequence, motif, reference, checkpoint, or fixed-window decoder fixtures that have not passed for GSE244832.

The ATAC value tree is label-free and reusable, but its direct model-input roster lacks the explicit 18-donor by 4-lineage missingness mask needed to distinguish 48 eligible units from four structurally missing and 20 below-QC units.

scientific_impact: No model prediction, prediction commit, metric, selection, biological outcome open, or sealed-data access occurred. Donor identities, lineages, fixed windows, query ATAC values, +4/-5 Tn5 geometry, and whole-contig masking remain reusable through a stricter execution authority.
replacement_rule: Only PeakVI, LSI, observed_atac_glm, and observed_atac_only may execute, only through a frozen registration carrying the explicit donor-lineage missingness mask. EpiBERT, EPCOTv2, GET, EpiAgent, scBasset embeddings, all sequence families, and RNA-paired families remain blocked. The prediction commit must bind the registration before any evaluator outcome is opened.
